description.en: List registered lowpoly batteries/ops

description.en: Execute a lowpoly pipeline or a single node. projectId is optional; defaults to the currently open/viewed project

source.description: 完整 Geometry DSL 文本（每行一条 id = op(args) 语句）

name.description: 可选模型名（用于 URDF <robot name>）

execute.description: 是否执行图并跑 QC + 导出（默认 true）

pipeline.description: 可选：强制指定管线（绕过 DSL 内容推断）。省略时按内容推断：含 skin/skeleton → character（角色骨架蒙皮）；含 joint → mechanical（URDF 关节）；两者皆无 → static（纯静态物体/场景 → 单个 .glb）。

bake.description: 阶段1 单件烘焙：填要烘焙的 shape id（或 true=烘最后一条语句），追加 g_bake_part 终端而非终端链，返回 <sha>.obj + bbox 并登记到 parts.json；供阶段2 用 mesh(filename=...) 引用。

expectedDims.description: 可选 brief 目标尺寸 [x,y,z]；仅生成非阻断尺寸偏差建议。

features.description: 可选显著特征清单；原样回显供非阻断复核。

description.zh: DSL-first 建模主入口：传入完整 Geometry DSL 文本，后端一次完成 校验+编译成图+执行+QC，返回紧凑回执（错误/QC 信号定位到 DSL 行号 + mesh-aware 穿模硬信号）。回执按管线三分（回执带 mode 字段）：static→qc + scene 指纹（无 URDF）；mechanical(urdf)→qc + URDF 指纹；character→skinQc + rig 指纹。管线由 DSL 内容自动推断（含 skin/skeleton=character、含 joint=mechanical、皆无=static），可用 pipeline 参数强制覆盖。你只写 DSL，绝不手工 createNode/connect；projectId 可选，省略时默认当前打开的项目。
description.en: DSL-first modeling entry point: pass the full Geometry DSL text; the backend validates, compiles it to a graph, executes, and runs QC in one call, returning a compact receipt (errors / QC signals mapped to DSL line numbers + mesh-aware interpenetration hard signals). The receipt is split three ways by pipeline (carries a `mode` field): static → qc + scene fingerprint (no URDF); mechanical (urdf) → qc + URDF fingerprint; character → skinQc + rig fingerprint. The pipeline is inferred from DSL content (skin/skeleton = character, joint = mechanical, neither = static) and can be forced with the `pipeline` arg. You only write DSL — never hand-wire createNode/connect. projectId optional; defaults to the open project.

description.zh: 读回当前模型的 Geometry DSL 源（从图反解，人在编辑器改过图也能读到等价 DSL）。projectId 可选。
description.en: Read back the current model's Geometry DSL source (reconstructed from the graph, so human edits in the editor are reflected). projectId optional.

description.zh: 批量、逐件独立编译并烘焙最多 16 个 Geometry DSL 零件；部分失败不回滚已成功零件，返回每件紧凑回执。
description.en: Compile and bake up to 16 independent Geometry DSL parts. Partial failures do not roll back successful parts; returns compact per-item receipts.

description.zh: 按 1-based 行号增量修改当前 Geometry DSL；baseHash 不匹配时拒绝并要求 model.get，避免覆盖并发编辑。
description.en: Patch current Geometry DSL by 1-based line number. Rejects stale baseHash values so concurrent edits are not overwritten.

description.zh: 列出本项目已 bake 的 mesh 清单（name → sha256 + 未缩放 bbox + 尺寸），供阶段2 用 g_mesh 引用；直接解决"找不到已 bake 的 mesh"。projectId 可选。
description.en: List this project's baked meshes (name → sha256 + unscaled bbox + dims) for phase-2 g_mesh references; solves 'can't find the mesh I baked'. projectId optional.

description.zh: 导入/替换 lowpoly pipeline graph。projectId 可选，省略时默认当前打开/查看的项目
description.en: Import or replace a lowpoly pipeline graph. projectId is optional; defaults to the currently open/viewed project

description.zh: 导出当前 pipeline 模板。projectId 可选，省略时默认当前打开/查看的项目
description.en: Export the current pipeline template. projectId is optional; defaults to the currently open/viewed project

description.zh: 列出 lowpoly 模型/贴图等项目资产
description.en: List lowpoly model, texture, and project assets

path.description: 保存到磁盘的 PNG 绝对路径；用 read_file 打开它来查看图像 / absolute path of the saved PNG; open it with read_file to view the image

description.zh: （内部 / 人工用，不暴露给 AI）请求渲染器截图：返回正交四视图 contact sheet（前/侧/顶/等轴 2×2），存盘并返回 PNG 绝对路径。AI 的形态判据是 model.apply 回执里的 mesh-aware QC，不靠截图。
description.en: (internal / human use, not exposed to AI) Request a renderer screenshot: returns an orthographic 4-view contact sheet (Front/Side/Top/Iso 2×2), saves the PNG and returns its absolute path. The AI judges form from model.apply's mesh-aware QC receipt, not from screenshots.

path.description: 保存到磁盘的 PNG 绝对路径；用 read_file 打开它来查看图像 / absolute path of the saved PNG; open it with read_file to view the image

description.zh: （内部 / 人工用，不暴露给 AI）读取最近一次 lowpoly 预览截图：存盘并返回 PNG 绝对路径。
description.en: (internal / human use, not exposed to AI) Read the latest lowpoly preview screenshot: saves the PNG and returns its absolute path.

description.zh: 渲染器回写截图数据（内部）
description.en: Renderer callback to store screenshot data

name.description: 输出文件名（不含扩展名）；落到 assets/3d/<name>.glb

mode.description: 导出模式：animated（默认，机械路：关节预览/作者动画轨道）/ static（仅几何+材质，无动画，无需 URDF spec）/ skinned（URDF 标准骨骼蒙皮，每连杆刚绑到关节骨）/ character（角色路：骨架+平滑蒙皮，前端体素权重，含骨骼动画；需已走 rig_preview/g_to_rig）

animated.description: [已弃用，建议改用 mode] 是否把关节预览轨迹烘成 glTF 动画。默认 true；传 false 等价 mode='static'。mode 存在时以 mode 为准

description.zh: 把当前 pipeline 的模型烘焙导出为引擎中立的 .glb，落到项目 assets/3d/。mode 选导出模式：animated（默认，含关节动画，需图已 execute 出 URDF）/ static（仅几何+材质）/ skinned（URDF 刚性骨骼蒙皮）/ character（角色骨架+平滑蒙皮，需走角色路 rig_preview）。旧参数 animated:false 等价 mode='static'
description.en: Bake the current pipeline model to an engine-neutral .glb under the project assets/3d/. `mode` selects the flavor: animated (default, joint animation, requires g_to_urdf output) / static (geometry + materials only) / skinned (URDF rigid bone skinning) / character (character skeleton + smooth skinning, requires the character path rig_preview). Legacy animated:false is equivalent to mode='static'.
